chapters.label: Open the server and its Users tab — permission is checked first
Click “+ Add user” — a name and, if you like, a full name
Set a password — or generate a strong one
Tick “Generate a new key pair” for SSH login
Access: sudo, without a password prompt, and the docker group
Download the private key — it is shown only once
The new user: sudo, a key, the docker group
Actions → SSH keys: see, add or remove keys
Actions → Lock login: shut it out, files untouched
Actions → Delete: keep the home folder, or delete it too
